skills.detail:
Puts the character in the Icy Chill of Hell state.
While in the Icy Chill of Hell state, the character cannot be Staggered, and the character gains Status Effect Nullification.
Also deals a long-range area attack with a Knockback effect.
Deals increased damage to Runners.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.

skills.detail:
Puts the character in the Icy Chill of Hell state.
While in the Icy Chill of Hell state, the character cannot be Staggered, and the character gains Status Effect Nullification.
Also spawns a spectral form at close range.
This spectral form can be moved while the skill button is held down, dealing damage to enemies in close range of the spectral form with a chance to Freeze.
This spectral form vanishes after a certain amount of time passes or when the skill button is released.
Damage dealt will disregard the enemy DEF stat.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
